verdict.rationale: Cline is an agent platform with its own provider accounts, so issuing scoped credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, shows no feature for minting scoped or least-privilege API credentials. Bring-your-own-key (BYOK) provider keys and Auto Approve action controls are adjacent features, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
